# Part 8 — Character sheets (GENERATED by `sheets.py`; do not edit by hand)

## Status: PROPOSED. Generated by `python -I proposals/2026-11-20-pc-tradition-jobs-growth/sheets.py`. Every figure under *What the engine derives*, every technique's engine figure, and every *Measured* line is computed by the live `modules.combat` package in this run. Board, attention, stage, sets and growth path are proposal data, marked as such. The persons, their levels and attributes are invented for illustration [ASSUMPTION; low].

**How to read a sheet.** A *tradition* is the fighter's school. A *technique* is something the school teaches, with a level from 1 (just learned) to 8 (mastered). The *board* is what the fighter brings to this fight. *Status* says whether the technique exists in the engine today (LIVE), comes from an earlier draft (DRAFT), or is invented in this proposal (NEW); *-NL* means the thing it acts on is not built yet, so it does nothing in a fight today. *Engine figure* is the multiplier (×) or addition (+) the engine applies at that level.
